items.title: Define a shared oracle row contract for gate/status artifacts
items.context: Extract or formalize the row shape currently used by DONE pre-checks so each gate exposes stable id/status/detail/hint/source semantics. Renderers should consume rows instead of matching labels or phases.
items.userSees: 用户在相关测试输出里看到 "DONE pre-check row exposes id=delivery-check and hint=koala delivery_check_set ..."；代码审阅时看到 status renderer 消费 row.id/row.hint，而不是匹配 "delivery-check" 这类展示 label。

happy.desc: DONE pre-check row 暴露稳定 id/status/detail/hint/source/blocking 语义，status renderer 可按 id 与 hint 渲染，不依赖 label 文案。

edge.desc: 新增 delivery-check 或 summary 等失败项时，row hint 能被 status/next 直接消费，label 文案变化不影响 next step。

adversarial.desc: renderer 若只知道 phase=TEST 但没有调用 DONE oracle rows，不得输出乐观 story_advance DONE 提示；必须降级指向 pre-check 失败项。

verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD verifies stable oracle row contract fields through flow-stability smoke assertions for row id/status/detail/hint/source/blocking consumption.
Current HEAD verifies delivery-check and summary row hints drive status/next output so label wording changes do not affect next-step guidance.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke && node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --json
verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD covers the real local CLI validate path and prevents optimistic DONE guidance when renderer lacks DONE oracle pre-check rows.

items.title: Refactor status and next renderers to consume oracle outputs only
items.context: Audit session_brief/status/next/reviewer status paths and remove duplicated gate knowledge. Reviewer routing must share computeActiveReviewers; DONE guidance must come from gate rows; Anti-stall must distinguish blockers from pending reviewer evidence.
items.userSees: 用户运行 "koala status --concise" 时看到 "Next: 补齐 DONE pre-check 失败项：git working tree dirty; delivery-check 缺失; Story summary 缺失"，而不是只看到 "git add + git commit，再 advance DONE"。

happy.desc: TEST 阶段缺 git clean、delivery-check、summary 时，status next step 显示这些具体失败项与补救命令，而不是直接提示 DONE。

edge.desc: 存在 docs 相关 git touchpoint 但未显式记录 docs reviewer 时，status 与 artifact contract 都要求 docs reviewer，不出现一个显示一个不显示。

adversarial.desc: finding 已 resolved 或 reviewer evidence 已通过时，Anti-stall 不得继续渲染 blocked by unresolved findings 这类过期阻塞文案。

verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD verifies TEST status next step lists dirty tree, delivery-check, and story-summary pre-check failures instead of directly advancing DONE.
Current HEAD verifies markdown touchpoints trigger docs reviewer fallback consistently in reviewer status and artifact contract status.
Current HEAD verifies resolved findings no longer render REVIEW anti-stall text claiming unresolved findings still block progress.

items.title: Add regression coverage for renderer and gate consistency
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage that creates synthetic stories with missing delivery/summary/dirty tree/docs reviewer/resolved findings and asserts status/next mirrors the gate output without optimistic DONE guidance.
items.userSees: 开发者运行 "npm --prefix packages/main run test:flow-stability-smoke" 后看到 "flow-stability smoke passed"；运行 "koala validate --json" 后看到 "allPass": true 且 command 为真实 pytest/npm 验证命令。

happy.desc: flow-stability smoke 构造 TEST story，断言 status/next 输出包含 delivery_check_set、summary_set、git commit 等真实 DONE pre-check 失败项。

edge.desc: smoke 覆盖 docs reviewer fallback 与 artifact/status 一致性，防止 docs gate 被 status 漏显。

adversarial.desc: smoke 覆盖 resolved finding 后 anti-stall 不显示 unresolved blocker，防止旧阻塞文案复发。

verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD smoke constructs TEST story and asserts status/next includes delivery_check_set, summary_set, and git commit remediation from DONE pre-check rows.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:entrypoints && npm run test:codex-assets
verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD entrypoint and codex asset checks cover docs/adapter fallback consistency including stale global fallback current-worktree boundary warnings.
Current HEAD smoke covers resolved finding anti-stall regression and confirms stale unresolved-blocker wording stays absent.
